_comment: Clock-gating and logic-depth units for MI's MIU RTL (tools/check-cg.py, tools/check-ngd.py; docs/rtl-coding-style.md, 'Local clock gating' and 'Logic depth'; the partition is MA's Phase 2, MIU tab rev 147). Each bench is the module's value-model bench (test/miu/*_tb.cpp) in its --cg mode, built by test/miu/cg-build.sh at the unit's parameters: idle is reset and then no work, medium work on about a third of the cycles, high work nearly every cycle. miu_cap is one address slot's ccv_rcu_miu_addr capture at its one size; miu_pair pairs the four slots' addresses with their memops at its one size (LAG 3, 40 entries, the 63-bit A1 view of miu_mq); miu_mq is the memop queue's slice 1 at its one size (40 entries, 10 a slot, the 126-bit payload). miu_agu8 is one slot's lane octet of A1's sums at its one size (8 lanes, the ordinary and sized forms; MI-21 holds the slot, local and private forms). miu_cred is the DCU bank credits and the A1 credit gate at its one size (8 banks, 16 entry and 12 store-data credits a bank).
